findings.title: Register cleanup for the created IDP alias, not the literal "alias"
findings.body: Each created provider is named `idp-alias-<i>`, but the cleanup callback is registered against `identityProviders().get("alias")`. The cleanup will therefore attempt to delete a non-existent provider and leave all providers created by this test behind (the same issue occurs for `idp-alias-20` at line 425). This can pollute the shared test realm and cause later tests or reruns to observe unexpected IDPs. Register cleanup using the actual alias created in each case.
